continuity: Avalon Hill HeroQuest Game System F3649, 2021 retail core
work_or_witness: HeroQuest Game System F3649 official product description
description: The named Dread sorcerer whose evil forces the four player heroes challenge; one player takes the Game Master role of Zargon in tabletop play.

roles_and_vocations.note: The official core-product text names Zargon as the Dread sorcerer.
The core product assigns one player the Game Master role of Zargon.

affiliations.note: The product frames the heroes as challenging Zargon's evil forces.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The product says the Realm needs champions against Zargon; no broader geography is asserted.

narrative_archetypes.note: He is the named opponent of the heroes in the core product description.

game_mechanics.note: This is a tabletop control role, not a separate character identity.

canon_status: official retail-core antagonist and player-role witness

supports: Names Zargon as the Game Master and Dread sorcerer whose evil forces the heroes challenge.

comparison_cautions: Zargon's Game Master function is an asymmetrical tabletop role as well as a story antagonist; it should not be treated as an independent player-character class.
'Dread sorcerer' is source-native fantasy terminology, not evidence about real religious or magical practice.
